wizard.resourcetype-tooltip: FHIR resource type that corresponds to this questionnaire item
wizard.resourceelement-tooltip: FHIR element that corresponds to this questionnaire item
wizard.group-hint: Group: only definitionExtract on resourceType level
wizard.reread-qr: Re-read the QuestionnaireResponse from the form
wizard.refresh-qr: Fill in the form above, then click Refresh QR

fixed-values.group: Inject fixed values into the extracted resource (e.g. Observation.status = final, category, subject). Observation.code is auto-wired from the SNOMED code above.
fixed-values.no-group: Inject fixed companion values alongside the answer (e.g. valueQuantity.system / code for unit metadata).

no-resource-categories.title: Step 1 - Configure this group
no-resource-categories.body: Select a Resource Type below. Each time this group appears in a filled-in form, one FHIR resource of that type will be extracted. Child items inside this group map their answers into fields of that resource.

resource-categories.title: This group extracts into: {{resourceCategories}}
resource-categories.body: Child items annotated with an Element Path will be written into the {{resourceCategories}} resource.

flat-mode.title: Flat mapping
flat-mode.body: This item is directly extracted into a {{resourceCategories}} resource (no parent group required).

no-parent-extract.title: Parent group not configured
no-parent-extract.parentgrouplabel: The parent group {{parentGroupLabel}} has no Resource Type set. Click that group first, assign a Resource Type (e.g. Observation) and save — otherwise this item's mapping will be silently ignored during extraction.
no-parent-extract.no-parentgrouplabel: No ancestor group with a Resource Type was found. Annotations on this item will be ignored until a parent group is configured.

parent-extract.title: Parent group:
parent-extract.body: Select an Element Path below to map this answer into {{parentResourceType}}.[path] during extraction.

extraction.title: Extraction Preview
extraction.disclaimer: This preview is computed locally by this tool — it is not the FHIR server's native $extract operation. Output may differ from a conformant FHIR server implementation.
extraction.no-lforms-data: No LForms data found. Fill in the form first.
extraction.modal-body-1: Are you sure you want to save this?
extraction.modal-body-2: Resources will be saved in the FHIR store.

no-extraction-groups.error: No extraction groups configured. Click a GROUP item in the form, select a Resource Type (e.g. Observation) and save it before extracting.

no-ancestor-groups.warning: Item {{leafId}} has a FHIR path configured but none of its ancestor groups has a Resource Type set. Its answer will be ignored during extraction.
